env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd g
go build -o $WORK/plain.a .
go tool pack t $WORK/plain.a
stdout '^__\.PKGDEF$'
? go tool pack p $WORK/plain.a __.LOGOS
! stdout 'AlwaysNilError'

logos build -o $WORK/driven.a .
go tool pack p $WORK/driven.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn AlwaysNil .*AlwaysNilError'
! stdout '^fn Sometimes .*AlwaysNilError'
cd ..

-- g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- g/g.go --
package g

import "errors"

var errFail = errors.New("fail")

var fail = false

func AlwaysNil() error {
	return nil
}

func Sometimes() error {
	if fail {
		return errFail
	}
	return nil
}
